gallery.about.body:
Welcome to MWNF Galleries!  
  
Each Gallery focuses on a specific medium, which means a specific material or type of object. This Gallery is dedicated to **Wall Paintings and Frescoes**.  
  
For now, in this Gallery you will find artefacts related to *Wall Paintings and Frescoes* from other MWNF databases, namely [Discover Islamic Art](https://islamicart.museumwnf.org/), [Discover Baroque Art](<https://baroqueart.museumwnf.org/ >) and [Sharing History](https://sharinghistory.museumwnf.org/). In the coming months and years, all Galleries will be expanded with new material added by our partners. So please come back regularly to check for updates!  
  
We suggest you start your visit in the [Collection](https://wallpaintings.museumwnf.org/collection), where a range of filters offers different options to explore the available material. For research, you can use the **Search** bar, located on the top right of the page. If you are interested in learning about contributions from a specific institution, the [Partner](https://wallpaintings.museumwnf.org/partners) section would be the best place to start. On the [Timeline](https://wallpaintings.museumwnf.org/timeline) you will find countries’ historical context information, while [My Collection](https://www.museumwnf.org/mycollection/index.php) lets you add any item from this project to your personal collection.  
  
Please be aware that the **Search** tool covers only the artefacts in this Gallery. If you wish to carry out a search in the overall MWNF Database, please click [here](https://www.museumwnf.org/database_searchform.php) or go to the above-mentioned projects to search their databases.
